backgroundInformationList.description: Declaration of Surplus Property - 9 Wardlaw Crescent

noticeDescription:
NOTICE is hereby given that in accordance with the City of Toronto’s real estate disposal By-law, the following City-owned parcel of lands was declared surplus on October 30, 2026:

 

The property municipally known as 9 Wardlaw Crescent, being the entirety of PIN 07321-0174 (LT), legally described as PT LT 34 CON B FRONTING THE HUMBER AS IN EB542742 ETOBICOKE, CITY OF TORONTO, and the entirety of PIN 07321-0175 (LT), legally described as PT LT 34 CON B FRONTING THE HUMBER AS IN TB872502 ETOBICOKE, CITY OF TORONTO. The property has a total area of approximately 1,876 m² (20,193 sq. ft.).

 

The City proposes that the intended manner of disposal be by way of a long-term lease to such entities as may be authorized by City Council, for the purpose of providing affordable housing, together with all ancillary uses related thereto, or benefitting or contributing to the principal use.

 

The following City official has information about the proposed disposition: Desiree Picchiello, Project Manager, Tel: 416-338-5028, Metro Hall, 55 John Street, 2nd floor, Toronto, Ontario M5V 3C6. Enquiries may be made of the said official until November 24, 2026.
